question: Was there anything in particular that surprised you while being involved in the production of the anime?
answer:
I was absolutely amazed by how good the voice actors are at getting a feel for their characters, as well as grasping the nuances of what you want them to convey in each scene!

All the voice actors working on Re are incredibly good at understanding their characters, so when I go to the recording sessions, there's almost nothing I need to say about the acting. I usually just sit off to the side and listen (laughs).

Of course, when it comes to the Re series as a whole, I think the original author, Nagatsuki, understands it better than anyone. But when it comes to the amount of time each individual voice actor has spent engaging with their particular character, they've spent more time with them, and they've gone deeper.

They think of the characters as if they were their own, so in that respect, I feel that even the original author can't beat them. Seeing each of them bring their respective characters to life so vividly is probably what surprises me the most, and it's also one of the things that makes me happiest.
